memoryHelped.question: What is the encryption key rotation period for Manufacturing?
memoryHelped.offAnswer: 540 days (Manufacturing IT Equipment and Encryption Policy, issued 2023-06-13)
memoryHelped.onAnswer: 150 days. The 2025 Manufacturing Hardware Lifecycle and Key Management Standard (effective 2025-06-27) calls this the "key renewal interval". It replaced the 2023 policy, which set 540 days.

memoryHelped.question: What is the release freeze length before quarter end for Manufacturing?
memoryHelped.offAnswer: 13 days, per the latest Manufacturing policy (revision LW, issued 2025-11-28). Two older revisions give different numbers: FW (2025-11-17) says 9 days and WC (2024-03-16) says 3 days. I treated the most recently issued one as current.
memoryHelped.onAnswer: 13 days (current revision LW, issued 2025-11-28; it supersedes FW with 9 days and WC with 3 days).

memoryHelped.question: What is the refund approval limit for Manufacturing?
memoryHelped.offAnswer: $5,500, from the latest Manufacturing policy (revision SJ, issued 2025-08-24). Two earlier revisions give different figures: LK (2025-08-12) says $7,900 and MG (2025-03-19) says $7,600. I treated the most recently issued revision as current.
memoryHelped.onAnswer: $5,500 (per the latest Manufacturing policy, revision SJ, issued 2025-08-24; it supersedes earlier revisions LK $7,900 and MG $7,600).

memoryHurt.question: What is the encryption key rotation period for Research?
memoryHurt.offAnswer: 330 days. The 2025 Research Working Hours and Key Management Standard (effective 2025-01-07) sets the key renewal interval at 330 days. It replaced the 2023 policy, which said 630 days.
memoryHurt.onAnswer: 330 days. The Research Working Hours and Key Management Standard (effective 2025-01-07) calls it the "key renewal interval". It replaces the 2023 policy, which set 630 days.

memoryHurt.question: What is the backup retention period for Marketing?
memoryHurt.offAnswer: 175 days. This comes from the Marketing Recruitment and Data Protection Standard, effective 2025-07-16, which calls it the "snapshot keep period". It replaces the 2023 policy that said 385 days.
memoryHurt.onAnswer: 175 days. This comes from the Marketing Recruitment and Data Protection Standard, effective 2025-07-16, which replaced the 2023 policy that said 385 days.

memoryHurt.question: What is the commuter subsidy for Research?
memoryHurt.offAnswer: Research's current commuter (transit) benefit is $80 per month, under the Hybrid Working and Transit Benefits Standard effective 2025-07-11. That standard replaced the 2023 policy, which gave $130 per month.
memoryHurt.onAnswer: Research's commuter (transit) benefit is currently $80 per month, under the Hybrid Working and Transit Benefits Standard effective 2025-07-11. That standard replaced the 2023 policy, which set the commuter subsidy at $130 per month.
